description: Declarative skill chains — ordered, named pipelines that capture the fe-skill-registry 'multi-skill scenarios' as runnable sequences. Single source for: workflow commands, the routing reminder hooks, and the eventual skill planner. agent-os/evals/check.ts asserts every step (and optional step) references a real skill directory; triggers are kept consistent with agent-os/docs/skill-triggers.md. Steps run in order; each step is an existing skill invoked by name.

page-change.description: Adding or changing a page / route island end-to-end.

fe-component-promotion.description: Promoting a page-local component up the ladder into shared / family-shared.

fe-resource-crud.description: Scaffolding a backend resource UI — list page plus URL-driven create/edit dialogs.

ui-review.description: Building or restyling UI — craft, accessibility, and motion review.

form-mutation.description: Building a form that mutates via apiClient and maps server/validation errors.

data-hook.description: Adding a TanStack Query hook / data layer over the fetch client.

styling.description: Styling / theming with semantic tokens and Tailwind.

env-change.description: Adding, renaming, or removing an env var and keeping schema + templates in sync.

new-guard.description: Adding a machine-enforced invariant (validator, eslint restriction, CI static-sync step).

pr-readiness.description: Final pass before opening a pull request or requesting review. Intent-triggered — no file glob; a glob here would match every change.

i18n-surface.description: Adding or changing user-facing copy, dates/numbers, or locale preferences.

fe-review-response.description: Working a code-review report or PR review threads to completion. Intent-triggered — no file glob; a glob here would match every change.

agent-os-change.description: Adding, renaming or removing an agent-os skill or rule.
